original: Manu05-39a/ yaj;nārthaṃ pa;savaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayam eva svayaṃbhuvā |

original: Manu05-39c/ yaj;no 'asya bhūtyai sarvasya tasmād yaj;ne vadho 'a-vadhaḥ ‖

original: Manu05-40a/ oṣadhyaḥ pa;savo vṛkṣās tirya;ncaḥ pakṣiṇas tathā |

original: Manu05-41c/ atra-eva pa;savo hiṃsyā na-anyatra-ity abravīn manuḥ ‖

original: Manu05-42c/ ātmānaṃ ca pa;suṃ ca-eva gamayaty uttamaṃ gatim ‖

original: Manu05-43a/ gṛhe gurāv araṇye vā nivasann ātmavān dvijaḥ |
analyzed: gṛhe gurau araṇye vā nivasan ātmavān dvijaḥ

analyzed: yā veda vihitā hiṃsā niyatā asmin cara acare

original: Manu05-45a/ yo 'ahiṃsakāni bhūtāni hinasty ātmasukha-icchayā |
analyzed: yaḥ ahiṃsakāni bhūtāni hinasti ātma sukha ecchayā

original: Manu05-45c/ sa jīvāṃ;s ca mṛta;s ca-eva na kva cit sukham edhate ‖
analyzed: sa jīvān ca mṛtas ca eva na kva cit sukham edhate

original: Manu05-46a/ yo bandhanavadhakle;sān prāṇināṃ na cikīrṣati |
analyzed: yaḥ bandhana vadha klesān prāṇinām na cikīrṣati

original: Manu05-46c/ sa sarvasya hitaprepsuḥ sukham atyantam a;snute ‖

analyzed: yat dhyāyati yat kurute ratim badhnāti yatra ca

analyzed: na a kṛtvā prāṇinām hiṃsām māṃsam utpadyate kva cit

original: Manu05-48c/ na ca prāṇivadhaḥ svargyas tasmān māṃsaṃ vivarjayet ‖
analyzed: na ca prāṇi vadhaḥ svargyaḥ tasmāt māṃsam vivarjayet

original: Manu05-49a/ samutpattiṃ ca māṃsasya vadha-bandhau ca dehinām |
analyzed: samutpattim ca māṃsasya vadha bandhau ca dehinām

analyzed: prasamīkṣya nivarteta sarva māṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt

original: Manu05-50a/ na bhakṣayati yo māṃsaṃ vidhiṃ hitvā pi;sācavat |
analyzed: na bhakṣayati yaḥ māṃsam vidhim hitvā pisāca vat

original: Manu05-50c/ na loke priyatāṃ yāti vyādhibhi;s ca na pīḍyate ‖

analyzed: anumantā visasitā nihantā kraya vikrayī

analyzed: sva māṃsam para māṃsena yaḥ vardhayitum icchati

analyzed: mām sa bhakṣayitā amutra yasya māṃsam iha admi aham

original: Manu05-57a/ preta;suddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi) dravya;suddhiṃ tathā-eva ca |

analyzed: danta jāte anujāte ca kṛta cūḍe ca saṃsthite

analyzed: asuddhāḥ bāndhavāḥ sarve sūtake ca tathā ucyate

analyzed: R daśa aham sāvam āsaucam sapiṇḍeṣu vidhīyate

analyzed: sapiṇḍa tā tu puruṣe saptame vinivartate

analyzed: samānodaka bhāvaḥ tu janma nāmnoḥ avedane

analyzed: sarveṣām sāvam āsaucam mātā pitroḥ tu sūtakam janane api evam eva syāt mātā pitroḥ tu sūtakam

original: Manu05-62c[61ṃc]/ sūtakaṃ mātur eva syād) upaspṛ;sya pitā ;suciḥ //
analyzed: sūtakam mātuḥ eva syāt upaspṛsya pitā suciḥ

analyzed: nirvṛtta cūḍakānām tu tri rātrāt suddhiḥ iṣyate nirvṛtta muṇḍakānām

analyzed: R     nidadhyuḥ   bahis

analyzed: alaṃkṛtya sucau bhūmau asthisaṃcayanāt ṛte

analyzed: R astrīṇām asaṃskṛtānām tu tri ahāt sudhyanti bāndhavāḥ

analyzed: māṃsa āsanam ca na asnīyuḥ sayīran ca pṛthak kṣitau

original: Manu05-75a[74ṃa]/vigataṃ tu vide;sasthaṃ ;sṛṇuyād yo hy a-nirda;sam |
analyzed: R avigatam tu sṛṇuyāt yaḥ hi anirdasam

original: Manu05-77a[76ṃa]/ nirda;saṃ j;nātimaraṇaṃ  ;srutvā putrasya janma ca |
analyzed: nirdasam jnāti maraṇam srutvā putrasya janma ca

analyzed: sa vāsāḥ jalam āplutya suddhaḥ bhavati mānavaḥ

analyzed: tri rātram āhuḥ āsaucam ācārye saṃsthite sati

original: Manu05-80c[79ṃc]/ tasya putre ca patnyāṃ ca divā-rātram iti sthitiḥ ‖
analyzed: tasya putre ca patnyām ca divārātram iti sthitiḥ

analyzed: mātule pakṣiṇīm rātrim siṣya ṛtvij bāndhaveṣu ca

original: Manu05-82a[81ṃa]/ prete rājani sa-jyotir yasya syād viṣaye sthitaḥ |

original: Manu05-82c[81ṃc]/ a-;srotriye tv ahaḥ kṛtsnam anūcāne tathā gurau ‖ [ṃ-kṛtsnām ]

analyzed: vaisyaḥ pancadasa ahena sūdraḥ māsena sudhyati

analyzed: yadā bhāvena bhavati sarva bhāveṣu niḥspṛhaḥ

original: Manu06-80c/ tadā sukham avāpnoti pretya ca-iha ca ;sā;svatam ‖
analyzed: tadā sukham avāpnoti pretya ca eha ca sāsvatam

original: Manu06-81a/ anena vidhinā sarvāṃs tyaktvā sa:ngān-;sanaiḥ ;sanaiḥ |
analyzed: anena vidhinā sarvān tyaktvā san gān sanaiḥ sanaiḥ

original: Manu06-81c/ sarvadvandvavinirmukto brahmaṇy eva-avatiṣṭhate ‖
analyzed: sarva dvaṃdva vinirmuktaḥ brahmaṇi eva avatiṣṭhate

original: Manu06-82a/ dhyānikaṃ sarvam eva-etad yad etad abhi;sabditam |
analyzed: dhyānikam sarvam eva etat yat etat abhisabditam

original: Manu06-82c/ na hy an-adhyātmavit ka;s cit kriyāphalam upā;snute ‖
analyzed: na hi anadhyātmavid kaḥ cit kriyā phalam upāsnute

original: Manu06-83a/ adhiyaj;naṃ brahma japed ādhidaivikam eva ca |
analyzed: adhiyajnam brahma japet ādhidaivikam eva ca

original: Manu06-83c/ ādhyātmikaṃ ca satataṃ vedāntābhihitaṃ ca yat ‖
analyzed: ādhyātmikam ca satatam vedānta abhihitam ca yat

original: Manu06-84a/ idaṃ ;saraṇam aj;nānām idam eva vijānatām |
analyzed: idam saraṇam ajnānām idam eva vijānatām

original: Manu06-84c/ idam anvicchatāṃ svargam idam ānantyam icchatām ‖
analyzed: idam anvicchatām svargam idam ānantyam icchatām

original: Manu06-85a/ anena kramayogena parivrajati yo dvijaḥ |
analyzed: anena krama yogena parivrajati yaḥ dvijaḥ

original: Manu06-85c/ sa vidhūya-iha pāpmānaṃ paraṃ brahma-adhigacchati ‖
analyzed: sa vidhūya eha pāpmānam param brahma adhigacchati

original: Manu06-86a/ eṣa dharmo 'anu;siṣṭo vo yatīnāṃ niyata-ātmanām |
analyzed: eṣa dharmaḥ anusiṣṭaḥ vaḥ yatīnām niyata ātmanām

original: Manu06-86c/ vedasaṃnyāsikānāṃ tu karmayogaṃ nibodhata ‖
analyzed: vedasaṃnyāsikānām tu karma yogam nibodhata

original: Manu06-87a/ brahmacārī gṛhastha;s ca vānaprastho yatis tathā |
analyzed: brahmacārī gṛhasthaḥ ca vānaprasthaḥ yatiḥ tathā

original: Manu06-87c/ ete gṛhastha-prabhavā;s catvāraḥ pṛthag ā;sramāḥ ‖
analyzed: ete gṛhastha prabhavāḥ catvāraḥ pṛthak āsramāḥ

original: Manu06-88a/ sarve 'api krama;sas tv ete yathā;sāstraṃ niṣevitāḥ |
analyzed: sarve api kramasaḥ tu ete yathāsāstram niṣevitāḥ

original: Manu06-88c/ yathā-ukta-kāriṇaṃ vipraṃ nayanti paramāṃ gatim ‖
analyzed: yathā ukta kāriṇam vipram nayanti paramām gatim

original: Manu06-89a/ sarveṣām api ca-eteṣāṃ veda-smṛtividhānataḥ | [ṃ-veda-;srutividhānataḥ ]
analyzed: sarveṣām api ca eteṣām veda smṛti vidhānāt veda sruti vidhānāt

original: Manu06-89c/ gṛhastha ucyate ;sreṣṭhaḥ sa trīn etān bibharti hi ‖
analyzed: gṛhasthaḥ ucyate sreṣṭhaḥ sa trīn etān bibharti hi

original: Manu06-90a/ yathā nadī-nadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃsthitim |
analyzed: yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃsthitim

original: Manu06-90c/ tathā-eva-ā;sramiṇaḥ sarve gṛhasthe yānti saṃsthitim ‖
analyzed: tathā eva āsramiṇaḥ sarve gṛhasthe yānti saṃsthitim

original: Manu06-91a/ caturbhir api ca-eva-etair nityam ā;sramibhir dvijaiḥ |
analyzed: caturbhiḥ api ca eva etaiḥ nityam āsramibhiḥ dvijaiḥ

original: Manu06-91c/ da;sa-lakṣaṇako dharmaḥ sevitavyaḥ prayatnataḥ ‖
analyzed: dharmaḥ sevitavyaḥ prayatnāt

original: Manu06-92a/ dhṛtiḥ kṣamā damo 'asteyaṃ ;saucam indriyanigrahaḥ |
analyzed: dhṛtiḥ kṣamā damaḥ asteyam saucam indriya nigrahaḥ

original: Manu06-92c/ dhīr vidyā satyam akrodho da;sakaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam ‖
analyzed: dhī vidyā satyam akrodhaḥ dasakam dharma lakṣaṇam

original: Manu06-93a/ da;sa lakṣaṇāni dharmasya ye viprāḥ samadhīyate |
analyzed: dasa lakṣaṇāni dharmasya ye viprāḥ samadhīyate

original: Manu06-93c/ adhītya ca-anuvartante te yānti paramāṃ gatim ‖
analyzed: adhītya ca anuvartante te yānti paramām gatim

original: Manu06-94a/ da;sa-lakṣaṇakaṃ dharmam anutiṣṭhan samāhitaḥ |
analyzed: dasa lakṣaṇakam dharmam anutiṣṭhan samāhitaḥ

original: Manu06-94c/ vedāntaṃ vidhivat-;srutvā saṃnyased an-ṛṇo dvijaḥ ‖
analyzed: vedāntam vidhivat srutvā saṃnyaset anṛṇaḥ dvijaḥ

original: Manu06-95a/ saṃnyasya sarvakarmāṇi karmadoṣān apānudan |
analyzed: saṃnyasya sarva karmāṇi karma doṣān apānudan

original: Manu06-95c/ niyato vedam abhyasya putrai;svarye sukhaṃ vaset ‖
analyzed: niyataḥ vedam abhyasya putra aisvarye sukham vaset

original: Manu06-96a/ evaṃ saṃnyasya karmāṇi svakārya-paramo 'a-spṛhaḥ |
analyzed: evam saṃnyasya karmāṇi sva kārya paramaḥ aspṛhaḥ

original: Manu06-96c/ saṃnyāsena-apahatya-enaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ gatim ‖
analyzed: saṃnyāsena apahatya enaḥ prāpnoti paramam gatim

original: Manu06-97a/ eṣa vo 'abhihito dharmo brāhmaṇasya catur-vidhaḥ |
analyzed: eṣa vaḥ abhihitaḥ dharmaḥ brāhmaṇasya caturvidhaḥ

original: Manu06-97c/ puṇyo 'akṣaya-phalaḥ pretya rāj;nāṃ dharmaṃ nibodhata ‖
analyzed: puṇyaḥ akṣaya phalaḥ pretya rājnām dharmam nibodhata
R

original: Manu07-01a/ rājadharmān pravakṣyāmi yathāvṛtto bhaven nṛpaḥ |
analyzed: rāja dharmān pravakṣyāmi yathāvṛttaḥ bhavet nṛpaḥ

original: Manu07-01c/ saṃbhava;s ca yathā tasya siddhi;s ca paramā yathā ‖
analyzed: saṃbhavaḥ ca yathā tasya siddhiḥ ca paramā yathā

original: Manu07-02a/ brāhmaṃ prāptena saṃskāraṃ kṣatriyeṇa yathāvidhi |
analyzed: brāhmam prāptena saṃskāram kṣatriyeṇa yathāvidhi

original: Manu07-02c/ sarvasya-asya yathānyāyaṃ kartavyaṃ parirakṣaṇam ‖
analyzed: sarvasya asya yathānyāyam kartavyam parirakṣaṇam

original: Manu07-03a/ a-rājake hi loke 'asmin sarvato vidruto bhayāt |
analyzed: arājake hi loke asmin sarvatas vidrutaḥ bhayāt

original: Manu07-03c/ rakṣārtham asya sarvasya rājānam asṛjat prabhuḥ ‖
analyzed: rakṣā artham asya sarvasya rājānam asṛjat prabhuḥ

original: Manu07-04a/ indra-anila-yama-arkāṇām agne;s ca varuṇasya ca |
analyzed: indra anila yama arkāṇām agneḥ ca varuṇasya ca

original: Manu07-04c/ candra-vitte;sayo;s ca-eva mātrā nirhṛtya ;sā;svatīḥ ‖
analyzed: candravittesayoḥ ca eva mātrāḥ nirhṛtya sāsvatīḥ

original: Manu07-05a/ yasmād eṣāṃ surendrāṇāṃ mātrābhyo nirmito nṛpaḥ |
analyzed: yasmāt eṣām sura indrāṇām mātrābhyaḥ nirmitaḥ nṛpaḥ

original: Manu07-05c/ tasmād abhibhavaty eṣa sarvabhūtāni tejasā ‖
analyzed: tasmāt abhibhavati eṣa sarva bhūtāni tejasā

original: Manu07-06a/ tapaty ādityavac ca-eṣa cakṣūṃṣi ca manāṃsi ca |
analyzed: tapati ādityavat ca eṣa cakṣūṃṣi ca manāṃsi ca

original: Manu07-06c/ na ca-enaṃ bhuvi ;saknoti ka;s cid apy abhivīkṣitum ‖
analyzed: na ca enam bhuvi saknoti kaḥ cit api abhivīkṣitum

original: Manu07-07a/ so 'agnir bhavati vāyu;s ca so 'arkaḥ somaḥ sa dharmarāṭ |
analyzed: saḥ agniḥ bhavati vāyuḥ ca saḥ arkaḥ somaḥ sa dharmarāj

original: Manu07-07c/ sa kuberaḥ sa varuṇaḥ sa mahendraḥ prabhāvataḥ ‖ [ṃ-sa ca-indraḥ svaprabhāvataḥ] ‖ [K: ]

original: Manu07-08a/ bālo 'api na-avamāntavyo manuṣya iti bhūmipaḥ |
analyzed: bālaḥ api manuṣyaḥ iti bhūmipaḥ

original: Manu07-08c/ mahatī devatā hy eṣā nararūpeṇa tiṣṭhati ‖
analyzed: mahatī devatā hi eṣā nara rūpeṇa tiṣṭhati

original: Manu07-09a/ ekam eva dahaty agnir naraṃ durupasarpiṇam |

original: Manu07-10a/ kāryaṃ so 'avekṣya ;saktiṃ ca de;sa-kālau ca tattvataḥ |

original: Manu07-10c/ kurute dharmasiddhyarthaṃ vi;svarūpaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ‖
analyzed: kurute dharma siddhi artham visvarūpam punar punar

original: Manu07-11a/ yasya prasāde padmā ;srīr vijaya;s ca parākrame |
analyzed: yasya prasāde padmā srīḥ vijayaḥ ca parākrame

original: Manu07-11c/ mṛtyu;s ca vasati krodhe sarvatejomayo hi saḥ ‖
analyzed: mṛtyuḥ ca vasati krodhe sarva tejaḥ mayaḥ hi saḥ

original: Manu07-12a/ taṃ yas tu dveṣṭi saṃmohāt sa vina;syaty asaṃ;sayam |

original: Manu07-12c/ tasya hy ā;su vinā;sāya rājā prakurute manaḥ ‖
analyzed: tasya hi āsu vināsāya rājā prakurute manaḥ

original: Manu07-13a/ tasmād dharmaṃ yam iṣṭeṣu sa vyavasyen narādhipaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt dharmam yam iṣṭeṣu sa vyavasyet narādhipaḥ

original: Manu07-13c/ aniṣṭaṃ ca-apy aniṣṭeṣu taṃ dharmaṃ na vicālayet ‖
analyzed: aniṣṭam ca api aniṣṭeṣu tam dharmam na vicālayet

original: Manu07-14a/ tasyārthe sarvabhūtānāṃ goptāraṃ dharmam ātmajam | [ṃ-tadarthaṃ]
analyzed: tasya arthe sarva bhūtānām goptāram dharmam ātma jam

original: Manu07-14c/ brahmatejomayaṃ daṇḍam asṛjat pūrvam ī;svaraḥ ‖
analyzed: brahma tejaḥ mayam daṇḍam asṛjat pūrvam īsvaraḥ

original: Manu07-15a/ tasya sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca |
analyzed: tasya sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca

original: Manu07-15c/ bhayād bhogāya kalpante svadharmāt-na calanti ca ‖
analyzed: bhayāt bhogāya kalpante svadharmāt na calanti ca

original: Manu07-16a/ taṃ de;sa-kālau ;saktiṃ ca vidyāṃ ca-avekṣya tattvataḥ |
analyzed: tam desa kālau saktim ca vidyām ca avekṣya tattvataḥ

original: Manu07-16c/ yathārhataḥ saṃpraṇayen nareṣv anyāya-vartiṣu ‖
analyzed: yathārhatas saṃpraṇayet nareṣu anyāya vartiṣu

original: Manu07-17a/ sa rājā puruṣo daṇḍaḥ sa netā ;sāsitā ca saḥ |
analyzed: sa rājā puruṣaḥ daṇḍaḥ sa netā sa asitā ca saḥ

original: Manu07-17c/ caturṇām ā;sramāṇāṃ ca dharmasya pratibhūḥ smṛtaḥ ‖
analyzed: caturṇām āsramāṇām ca dharmasya pratibhūḥ smṛtaḥ

original: Manu07-18a/ daṇḍaḥ ;sāsti prajāḥ sarvā daṇḍa eva-abhirakṣati |
analyzed: daṇḍaḥ sā asti prajāḥ sarvāḥ daṇḍaḥ eva abhirakṣati

original: Manu07-18c/ daṇḍaḥ supteṣu jāgarti daṇḍaṃ dharmaṃ vidur budhāḥ ‖
analyzed: daṇḍaḥ supteṣu jāgarti daṇḍam dharmam viduḥ budhāḥ

original: Manu07-19a/ samīkṣya sa dhṛtaḥ samyak sarvā ra;njayati prajāḥ |
analyzed: samīkṣya sa dhṛtaḥ samyak sarvāḥ ranjayati prajāḥ

original: Manu07-19c/ a-samīkṣya praṇītas tu vinā;sayati sarvataḥ ‖
analyzed: a samīkṣya praṇītaḥ tu vināsayati sarvatas

original: Manu07-20a/ yadi na praṇayed rājā daṇḍaṃ daṇḍyeṣv atandritaḥ |
analyzed: yadi na praṇayet rājā daṇḍam daṇḍyeṣu atandritaḥ

original: Manu07-20c/ ;sūle matsyān iva-apakṣyan durbalān balavattarāḥ ‖
analyzed: sūle matsyān iva apakṣyan durbalān balavattarāḥ

original: Manu07-21a/ adyāt kākaḥ puroḍā;saṃ  ;svā ca lihyādd havis tathā | [ṃ-;svā-avalihyādd]
analyzed: adyāt kākaḥ puroḍāsam svā ca lihyāt haviḥ

original: Manu07-21c/ svāmyaṃ ca na syāt kasmiṃ;s cit pravarteta-adhara-uttaram ‖
analyzed: svāmyam ca na syāt kasmin cit pravarteta adharauttaram

original: Manu07-22a/ sarvo daṇḍajito loko durlabho hi ;sucir naraḥ |
analyzed: sarvaḥ daṇḍa jitaḥ lokaḥ durlabhaḥ hi suciḥ naraḥ

original: Manu07-22c/ daṇḍasya hi bhayāt sarvaṃ jagad bhogāya kalpate ‖
analyzed: daṇḍasya hi bhayāt sarvam jagat bhogāya kalpate

original: Manu07-23a/ deva-dānava-gandharvā rakṣāṃsi pataga-uragāḥ |
analyzed: deva dānava gandharvāḥ rakṣāṃsi pataga oragāḥ

original: Manu07-23c/ te 'api bhogāya kalpante daṇḍena-eva nipīḍitāḥ ‖
analyzed: te api bhogāya kalpante daṇḍena eva nipīḍitāḥ

original: Manu07-24a/ duṣyeyuḥ sarvavarṇā;s ca bhidyeran sarvasetavaḥ |
analyzed: duṣyeyuḥ sarva varṇāḥ ca bhidyeran sarva setavaḥ

original: Manu07-24c/ sarvalokaprakopa;s ca bhaved daṇḍasya vibhramāt ‖
analyzed: sarva loka prakopaḥ ca bhavet daṇḍasya vibhramāt

original: Manu07-25a/ yatra ;syāmo lohita-akṣo daṇḍa;s carati pāpahā |
analyzed: yatra syāmaḥ lohita akṣaḥ daṇḍaḥ carati pāpa hā

original: Manu07-25c/ prajās tatra na muhyanti netā cet sādhu pa;syati ‖
analyzed: prajāḥ tatra na muhyanti netā ced sādhu pasyati

original: Manu07-26a/ tasya-āhuḥ saṃpraṇetāraṃ rājānaṃ satyavādinam |
analyzed: tasya āhuḥ saṃpraṇetāram rājānam satya vādinam

original: Manu07-26c/ samīkṣyakāriṇaṃ prāj;naṃ dharma-kāma-artha-kovidam ‖
analyzed: samīkṣyakāriṇam prājnam dharma kāma artha kovidam

original: Manu07-27a/ taṃ rājā praṇayan samyak trivargeṇa-abhivardhate |
analyzed: tam rājā praṇayan samyak trivargeṇa abhivardhate

original: Manu07-27c/ kāma-ātmā viṣamaḥ kṣudro daṇḍena-eva nihanyate ‖ [ṃ-kāma-andho ]
analyzed: kāma ātmā viṣamaḥ kṣudraḥ daṇḍena eva nihanyate

original: Manu07-28a/ daṇḍo hi sumahat-tejo durdhara;s ca-akṛta-ātmabhiḥ |
analyzed: daṇḍaḥ hi su mahā tejaḥ durdharaḥ ca akṛtaātmabhiḥ

original: Manu07-28c/ dharmād vicalitaṃ hanti nṛpam eva sa-bāndhavam ‖
analyzed: dharmāt vicalitam hanti nṛpam eva sa bāndhavam

original: Manu07-29a/ tato durgaṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca lokaṃ ca sa-cara-acaram |
analyzed: tatas durgam ca rāṣṭram ca lokam ca sacaraacaram

original: Manu07-29c/ antarikṣagatāṃ;s ca-eva munīn devāṃ;s ca pīḍayet ‖
analyzed: antarikṣa gatān ca eva munīn devān ca pīḍayet

original: Manu07-30a/ so 'asahāyena mūḍhena lubdhena-akṛta-buddhinā |
analyzed: saḥ asahāyena mūḍhena lubdhena akṛtabuddhinā

original: Manu07-30c/ na ;sakyo nyāyato netuṃ saktena viṣayeṣu ca ‖
analyzed: na sakyaḥ nyāyatas netum saktena viṣayeṣu ca

original: Manu07-31a/ ;sucinā satyasaṃdhena yathā;sāstra-anusāriṇā |
analyzed: sucinā satya saṃdhena yathā sa astra anusāriṇā

original: Manu07-31c/ praṇetuṃ ;sakyate daṇḍaḥ susahāyena dhīmatā ‖
analyzed: praṇetum sakyate daṇḍaḥ su sahāyena dhīmatā

original: Manu07-32a/ svarāṣṭre nyāyavṛttaḥ syād bhṛ;sa-daṇḍa;s ca ;satruṣu |
analyzed: sva rāṣṭre nyāya vṛttaḥ syāt bhṛsa daṇḍaḥ ca satruṣu

original: Manu07-32c/ suhṛtsv ajihmaḥ snigdheṣu brāhmaṇeṣu kṣamānvitaḥ ‖
analyzed: suhṛtsu a jihmaḥ snigdheṣu brāhmaṇeṣu kṣamā anvitaḥ

original: Manu07-33a/ evaṃvṛttasya nṛpateḥ ;silā-u;nchena-api jīvataḥ |
analyzed: evaṃvṛttasya nṛpateḥ silāunchena api jīvataḥ

original: Manu07-33c/ vistīryate ya;so loke tailabindur iva-ambhasi ‖
analyzed: vistīryate yasaḥ loke taila binduḥ iva ambhasi

original: Manu07-34a/ atas tu viparītasya nṛpater ajita-ātmanaḥ |
analyzed: atas tu viparītasya nṛpateḥ ajita ātmanaḥ

original: Manu07-34c/ saṃkṣipyate ya;so loke ghṛtabindur iva-ambhasi ‖
analyzed: saṃkṣipyate yasaḥ loke ghṛta binduḥ iva ambhasi

original: Manu07-35a/ sve sve dharme niviṣṭānāṃ sarveṣām anupūrva;saḥ |
analyzed: sve sve dharme niviṣṭānām sarveṣām anupūrvasaḥ

original: Manu07-35c/ varṇānām ā;sramāṇāṃ ca rājā sṛṣṭo 'abhirakṣitā ‖
analyzed: varṇānām āsramāṇām ca rājā sṛṣṭaḥ abhirakṣitā

original: Manu07-36a/ tena yad yat sa-bhṛtyena kartavyaṃ rakṣatā prajāḥ |
analyzed: tena yat yat sa bhṛtyena kartavyam rakṣatā prajāḥ

original: Manu07-36c/ tat tad vo 'ahaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrva;saḥ ‖
analyzed: tat tat vaḥ aham pravakṣyāmi yathāvat anupūrvasaḥ

original: Manu07-37a/ brāhmaṇān paryupāsīta prātar utthāya pārthivaḥ |
analyzed: brāhmaṇān paryupāsīta prātar utthāya pārthivaḥ

original: Manu07-37c/ traividyavṛddhān viduṣas tiṣṭhet teṣāṃ ca ;sāsane ‖
analyzed: traividya vṛddhān viduṣaḥ tiṣṭhet teṣām ca sa āsane

original: Manu07-38a/ vṛddhāṃ;s ca nityaṃ seveta viprān vedavidaḥ ;sucīn |
analyzed: vṛddhān ca nityam seveta viprān veda vidaḥ sucīn

original: Manu07-38c/ vṛddhasevī hi satataṃ rakṣobhir api pūjyate ‖
analyzed: vṛddha sevī hi satatam rakṣobhiḥ api pūjyate

original: Manu07-39a/ tebhyo 'adhigacched vinayaṃ vinīta-ātmā-api nitya;saḥ |
analyzed: tebhyaḥ adhigacchet vinayam vinīta ātmā api nityasaḥ

original: Manu07-39c/ vinīta-ātmā hi nṛpatir na vina;syati karhi cit ‖
analyzed: vinīta ātmā hi nṛpatiḥ na vinasyati karhi cit

original: Manu07-40a/ bahavo 'avinayāt- naṣṭā rājānaḥ sa-paricchadāḥ |[ṃ-sa-parigrahāḥ]
analyzed: bahavaḥ avinayāt naṣṭāḥ rājānaḥ sa paricchadāḥ ṃsa parigrahāḥ

original: Manu07-40c/ vanasthā api rājyāni vinayāt pratipedire ‖
analyzed: vanasthāḥ api rājyāni vinayāt pratipedire

original: Manu07-41a/ veno vinaṣṭo 'avinayāt-nahuṣa;s ca-eva pārthivaḥ |
analyzed: venaḥ vinaṣṭaḥ ca eva pārthivaḥ

original: Manu07-41c/ sudāḥ paijavana;s ca-eva sumukho nimir eva ca ‖
analyzed: sudās paijavanaḥ ca eva sumukhaḥ nimiḥ eva ca

original: Manu07-42a/ pṛthus tu vinayād rājyaṃ prāptavān manur eva ca |
analyzed: pṛthuḥ tu vinayāt rājyam prāptavan manuḥ eva ca

original: Manu07-42c/ kubera;s ca dhanai;svaryaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ ca-eva gādhijaḥ ‖
analyzed: kuberaḥ ca dhanaisvaryam brāhmaṇyam ca eva gādhijaḥ

original: Manu07-43a/ traividyebhyas trayīṃ vidyāṃ daṇḍanītiṃ ca ;sā;svatīm | [ṃ-trayīṃ vidyāt ]
analyzed: traividyebhyaḥ trayīm vidyām daṇḍanītim ca sāsvatīm trayīm vidyāt

original: Manu07-43c/ ānvīkṣikīṃ ca-ātmavidyāṃ vārtārambhāṃ;s ca lokataḥ ‖
analyzed: ānvīkṣikīm ca ātma vidyām vārttā ārambhān ca lokatas

original: Manu07-44a/ indriyāṇāṃ jaye yogaṃ samātiṣṭhed divā-ni;sam |
analyzed: indriyāṇām jaye yogam samātiṣṭhet divānisam

original: Manu07-44c/ jita-indriyo hi ;saknoti va;se sthāpayituṃ prajāḥ ‖
analyzed: jita aindriyaḥ hi saknoti vase sthāpayitum prajāḥ

original: Manu07-45a/ da;sa kāma-samutthāni tathā-aṣṭau krodhajāni ca |
analyzed: dasa kāma samutthāni tathā aṣṭau krodha jāni ca

original: Manu07-45c/ vyasanāni dur-antāni prayatnena vivarjayet ‖
analyzed: vyasanāni durantāni prayatnena vivarjayet

original: Manu07-46a/ kāmajeṣu prasakto hi vyasaneṣu mahīpatiḥ |
analyzed: kāma jeṣu prasaktaḥ hi vyasaneṣu mahīpatiḥ

original: Manu07-46c/ viyujyate 'artha-dharmābhyāṃ krodhajeṣv ātmanā-eva tu ‖
analyzed: viyujyate artha dharmābhyām krodha jeṣu ātmanā eva tu

original: Manu07-47a/ mṛgayā-akṣo divāsvapnaḥ parivādaḥ striyo madaḥ |
analyzed: mṛgayā akṣaḥ divāsvapnaḥ parivādaḥ striyaḥ madaḥ

original: Manu07-47c/ tauryatrikaṃ vṛthāṭyā ca kāmajo da;sako gaṇaḥ ‖
analyzed: tauryatrikam vṛthāṭyā ca kāma jaḥ dasakaḥ gaṇaḥ

original: Manu07-48a/ pai;sunyaṃ sāhasaṃ droha īrṣyā-asūyā-arthadūṣaṇam |
analyzed: paisunyam sāhasam drohaḥ īrṣyā asūyā artha dūṣaṇam

original: Manu07-48c/ vāgdaṇḍajaṃ ca pāruṣyaṃ krodhajo 'api gaṇo 'aṣṭakaḥ ‖
analyzed: vāgdaṇḍa jam ca pāruṣyam krodha jaḥ api gaṇaḥ aṣṭakaḥ

original: Manu07-49a/ dvayor apy etayor mūlaṃ yaṃ sarve kavayo viduḥ |
analyzed: dvayoḥ api etayoḥ mūlam yam sarve kavayaḥ viduḥ

original: Manu07-49c/ taṃ yatnena jayet-lobhaṃ tajjāv etāv ubhau gaṇau ‖
analyzed: tam yatnena jayet lobham tad jau etau ubhau gaṇau

original: Manu07-50a/ pānam akṣāḥ striya;s ca-eva mṛgayā ca yathākramam |
analyzed: pānam akṣāḥ striyaḥ ca eva mṛgayā ca yathākramam

original: Manu07-50c/ etat kaṣṭatamaṃ vidyāt-catuṣkaṃ kāmaje gaṇe ‖
analyzed: etat kaṣṭatamam vidyāt catuṣkam kāma je gaṇe

original: Manu07-51a/ daṇḍasya pātanaṃ ca-eva vākpāruṣya-arthadūṣaṇe |
analyzed: daṇḍasya pātanam ca eva vāc pāruṣya artha dūṣaṇe

original: Manu07-51c/ krodhaje 'api gaṇe vidyāt kaṣṭam etat trikaṃ sadā ‖
analyzed: krodha je api gaṇe vidyāt kaṣṭam etat trikam sadā

original: Manu07-52a/ saptakasya-asya vargasya sarvatra-eva-anuṣa:ngiṇaḥ |
analyzed: saptakasya asya vargasya sarvatra eva anuṣangiṇaḥ

original: Manu07-52c/ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gurutaraṃ vidyād vyasanam ātmavān |
analyzed: pūrvam pūrvam gurutaram vidyāt vyasanam ātmavān

original: Manu07-53a/ vyasanasya ca mṛtyo;s ca vyasanaṃ kaṣṭam ucyate |
analyzed: vyasanasya ca mṛtyoḥ ca vyasanam kaṣṭam ucyate

original: Manu07-53c/ vyasany adho 'adho vrajati svar yāty avyasanī mṛtaḥ ‖
analyzed: vyasanī adhas adhas vrajati svar yāti avyasanī mṛtaḥ

original: Manu07-54a/ maulān-;sāstravidaḥ ;sūrān-labdha-lakṣān kula-udbhavān | [ṃ-kula-udgatān ]
analyzed: maulān sa astra vidaḥ sūrān labdhalakṣān kula udbhavān ṃ kula udgatān

original: Manu07-54c/ sacivān sapta ca-aṣṭau vā prakurvīta parīkṣitān ‖ [ṃ-kurvīta suparīkṣitān]
analyzed: sacivān sapta ca aṣṭau vā prakurvīta parīkṣitān kurvīta su parīkṣitān

original: Manu07-55a/ api yat sukaraṃ karma tad apy ekena duṣkaram |
analyzed: api yat sukaram karma tat api ekena duṣkaram

original: Manu07-55c/ vi;seṣato 'asahāyena kiṃ tu  rājyaṃ mahā-udayam ‖ [ṃ-kiṃ nu ]
analyzed: asahāyena kim tu rājyam mahā udayam nu

original: Manu07-56a/ taiḥ sārdhaṃ cintayen nityaṃ sāmānyaṃ saṃdhi-vigraham |
analyzed: taiḥ sārdham cintayet nityam sāmānyam saṃdhi vigraham

original: Manu07-56c/ sthānaṃ samudayaṃ guptiṃ labdhapra;samanāni ca ‖
analyzed: sthānam samudayam guptim labdha prasamanāni ca

original: Manu07-57a/ teṣāṃ svaṃ svam abhiprāyam upalabhya pṛthak pṛthak |
analyzed: teṣām svam svam abhiprāyam upalabhya pṛthak pṛthak

original: Manu07-57c/ samastānāṃ ca kāryeṣu vidadhyādd hitam ātmanaḥ ‖
analyzed: samastānām ca kāryeṣu vidadhyāt hitam ātmanaḥ

original: Manu07-58a/ sarveṣāṃ tu vi;siṣṭena brāhmaṇena vipa;scitā |
analyzed: sarveṣām tu visiṣṭena brāhmaṇena vipascitā

original: Manu07-58c/ mantrayet paramaṃ mantraṃ rājā ṣāḍguṇyasaṃyutam ‖
analyzed: mantrayet paramam mantram rājā ṣāḍguṇya saṃyutam

original: Manu07-59a/ nityaṃ tasmin samā;svastaḥ sarvakāryāṇi niḥkṣipet  | [ṃ-nikṣipet]
analyzed: nityam tasmin samāsvastaḥ sarva kāryāṇi niḥkṣipet nikṣipet

original: Manu07-59c/ tena sārdhaṃ vini;scitya tataḥ karma samārabhet ‖
analyzed: tena sārdham viniscitya tatas karma samārabhet

original: Manu07-60a/ anyān api prakurvīta ;sucīn prāj;nān avasthitān |
analyzed: anyān api prakurvīta sucīn prājnān avasthitān

original: Manu07-60c/ samyag arthasamāhartṝn amātyān suparīkṣitān ‖
analyzed: samyak artha samāhartṝn amātyān su parīkṣitān

original: Manu07-61a/ nirvarteta-asya yāvadbhir itikartavyatā nṛbhiḥ |
analyzed: nirvarteta asya yāvadbhiḥ itikartavya tā nṛbhiḥ

original: Manu07-61c/ tāvato 'atandritān dakṣān prakurvīta vicakṣaṇān ‖
analyzed: tāvataḥ atandritān dakṣān prakurvīta vicakṣaṇān

original: Manu07-62a/ teṣām arthe niyu;njīta ;sūrān dakṣān kula-udgatān |
analyzed: teṣām arthe niyunjīta sūrān dakṣān kula udgatān

original: Manu07-62c/ ;sucīn ākara-karmānte bhīrūn antarnive;sane ‖
analyzed: sucīn ākara karmānte bhīrūn antar nivesane

original: Manu07-63a/ dūtaṃ ca-eva prakurvīta sarva;sāstra-vi;sāradam |
analyzed: dūtam ca eva prakurvīta sarva sa astra visāra dam

original: Manu07-63c/ i:ngita-ākāra-ceṣṭaj;naṃ ;suciṃ dakṣaṃ kula-udgatam ‖
analyzed: sucim dakṣam kulaudgatam

original: Manu07-64a/ anuraktaḥ ;sucir dakṣaḥ smṛtimān de;sa-kālavit |
analyzed: anuraktaḥ suciḥ dakṣaḥ smṛtimān

original: Manu07-64c/ vapuṣmān vītabhīr vāgmī dūto rāj;naḥ pra;sasyate ‖
analyzed: vapuṣmān vīta bhīḥ vāgmī dūtaḥ rājnaḥ

original: Manu07-65a/ amātye daṇḍa āyatto daṇḍe vainayikī kriyā |
analyzed: amātye daṇḍaḥ āyattaḥ daṇḍe vainayikī kriyā

original: Manu07-65c/ nṛpatau ko;sa-rāṣṭre ca dūte saṃdhi-viparyayau ‖
analyzed: nṛpatau kosa rāṣṭre ca dūte saṃdhi viparyayau

original: Manu07-66a/ dūta eva hi saṃdhatte bhinatty eva ca saṃhatān |
analyzed: dūtaḥ eva hi saṃdhatte bhinatti eva ca saṃhatān

original: Manu07-66c/ dūtas tat kurute karma bhidyante yena mānavaḥ ‖
analyzed: dūtaḥ tat kurute karma bhidyante yena mānavaḥ

original: Manu07-67a/ sa vidyād asya kṛtyeṣu nirgūḍha-i:ngita-ceṣṭitaiḥ |
analyzed: sa vidyāt asya kṛtyeṣu nirgūḍha aingita ceṣṭitaiḥ

original: Manu07-67c/ ākāram i:ngitaṃ ceṣṭāṃ bhṛtyeṣu ca cikīrṣitam ‖
analyzed: ākāram ingitam ceṣṭām bhṛtyeṣu ca cikīrṣitam

original: Manu07-68a/ buddhvā ca sarvaṃ tattvena pararājacikīrṣitam |
analyzed: buddhvā ca sarvam tattvena para rāja cikīrṣitam

original: Manu07-68c/ tathā prayatnam ātiṣṭhed yathā-ātmānaṃ na pīḍayet ‖
analyzed: tathā prayatnam ātiṣṭhet yathā ātmānam na pīḍayet

original: Manu07-69a/ jā:ngalaṃ sasyasaṃpannam ārya-prāyam an-āvilam |
analyzed: jāngalam sasya saṃpannam ārya prāyam anāvilam

original: Manu07-69c/ ramyam ānata-sāmantaṃ svājīvyaṃ de;sam āvaset ‖
analyzed: ramyam ānata sāmantam su ājīvyam desam āvaset

original: Manu07-70a/ dhanva-durgaṃ mahī-durgam ab-durgaṃ vārkṣam eva vā |
analyzed: dhanva durgam mahī durgam ap durgam vārkṣam eva vā

original: Manu07-70c/ nṛdurgaṃ giridurgaṃ vā samā;sritya vaset puram ‖
analyzed: nṛ durgam giri durgam vā samāsritya vaset puram

original: Manu07-71a/ sarveṇa tu prayatnena giridurgaṃ samā;srayet |
analyzed: sarveṇa tu prayatnena giri durgam samāsrayet

original: Manu07-71c/ eṣāṃ hi bāhuguṇyena giridurgaṃ vi;siṣyate ‖
analyzed: eṣām hi bāhuguṇyena giri durgam visiṣyate

original: Manu07-72a/ triṇy ādyāny ā;sritās tv eṣāṃ mṛga-gartā;sraya-apcarāḥ |
analyzed: triṇi ādyāni āsritāḥ tu eṣām mṛga garta asra yaap carāḥ

original: Manu07-72c/ trīṇy uttarāṇi krama;saḥ plavaṃgama-nara-amarāḥ ‖
analyzed: trīṇi uttarāṇi kramasaḥ plavaṃgama nara amarāḥ

original: Manu07-73a/ yathā durgā;sritān etān na-upahiṃsanti ;satravaḥ |
analyzed: yathā durga asritān etān na upahiṃsanti satravaḥ

original: Manu07-73c/ tathā-arayo na hiṃsanti nṛpaṃ durgasamā;sritam ‖
analyzed: tathā arayaḥ na hiṃsanti nṛpam durga samāsritam

original: Manu07-74a/ ekaḥ ;sataṃ yodhayati prākārastho dhanurdharaḥ |
analyzed: ekaḥ yodhayati prākāra sthaḥ dhanurdharaḥ

original: Manu07-74c/ ;sataṃ da;sasahasrāṇi tasmād durgaṃ vidhīyate ‖
analyzed: tasmāt durgam vidhīyate

original: Manu07-75a/ tat syād āyudhasaṃpannaṃ dhana-dhānyena vāhanaiḥ |
analyzed: tat syāt āyudha saṃpannam dhana dhānyena vāhanaiḥ

original: Manu07-75c/ brāhmaṇaiḥ ;silpibhir yantrair yavasena-udakena ca ‖
analyzed: brāhmaṇaiḥ silpibhiḥ yantraiḥ yavasena audakena ca

original: Manu07-76a/ tasya madhye suparyāptaṃ kārayed gṛham ātmanaḥ |
analyzed: tasya madhye su paryāptam kārayet gṛham ātmanaḥ

original: Manu07-76c/ guptaṃ sarva-ṛtukaṃ ;subhraṃ jala-vṛkṣasamanvitam ‖
analyzed: guptam sarva ṛtukam subhram jala vṛkṣa samanvitam

original: Manu07-77a/ tad adhyāsya-udvahed bhāryāṃ sa-varṇāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām |
analyzed: tat adhyāsya udvahet bhāryām savarṇām lakṣaṇa anvitām

original: Manu07-77c/ kule mahati saṃbhūtāṃ hṛdyāṃ rūpa-guṇānvītām ‖
analyzed: kule mahati saṃbhūtām hṛdyām rūpa guṇa anvītām

original: Manu07-78a/ purohitaṃ ca kurvīta vṛṇuyād eva ca-ṛtvijaḥ |
analyzed: purohitam ca kurvīta vṛṇuyāt eva ca ṛtvijaḥ

original: Manu07-78c/ te 'asya gṛhyāṇi karmāṇi kuryur vaitānikāni ca ‖
analyzed: te asya gṛhyāṇi karmāṇi kuryuḥ vaitānikāni ca

original: Manu07-79a/ yajeta rājā kratubhir vividhair āpta-dakṣiṇaiḥ |
analyzed: yajeta rājā kratubhiḥ vividhaiḥ āpta dakṣiṇaiḥ

original: Manu07-79c/ dharmārthaṃ ca-eva viprebhyo dadyād bhogān dhanāni ca ‖
analyzed: dharma artham ca eva viprebhyaḥ dadyāt bhogān dhanāni ca

original: Manu07-80a/ sāṃvatsarikam āptai;s ca rāṣṭrād āhārayed balim |
analyzed: sāṃvatsarikam āptaiḥ ca rāṣṭrāt āhārayet balim

original: Manu07-80c/ syāc ca-āmnāya-paro loke varteta pitṛvat-nṛṣu ‖
analyzed: syāt ca āmnāya paraḥ loke varteta pitṛ vat nṛṣu

original: Manu07-81a/ adhyakṣān vividhān kuryāt tatra tatra vipa;scitaḥ |
analyzed: adhyakṣān vividhān kuryāt tatra tatra vipascitaḥ

original: Manu07-81c/ te 'asya sarvāṇy avekṣeran nṛṇāṃ kāryāṇi kurvatām ‖
analyzed: te asya sarvāṇi avekṣeran nṛṇām kāryāṇi kurvatām

original: Manu07-82a/ āvṛttānāṃ gurukulād viprāṇāṃ pūjako bhavet |
analyzed: āvṛttānām guru kulāt viprāṇām pūjakaḥ bhavet

original: Manu07-82c/ nṛpāṇām akṣayo hy eṣa nidhir brāhmo 'abhidhīyate ‖
analyzed: nṛpāṇām akṣayaḥ hi eṣa nidhiḥ brāhmaḥ abhidhīyate

original: Manu07-83a/ na taṃ stenā na ca-amitrā haranti na ca na;syati |
analyzed: na tam stenāḥ na ca amitrāḥ haranti na ca nasyati

original: Manu07-83c/ tasmād rāj;nā nidhātavyo brāhmaṇeṣv akṣayo nidhiḥ ‖
analyzed: tasmāt rājnā nidhātavyaḥ brāhmaṇeṣu akṣayaḥ nidhiḥ

original: Manu07-84a/ na skandate na vyathate na vina;syati karhi cit |[ṃ- na skandati na cyavate]
analyzed: na skandate na vyathate na vinasyati karhi cit na skandati na cyavate

original: Manu07-84c/ variṣṭham agnihotrebhyo brāhmaṇasya mukhe hutam ‖
analyzed: variṣṭham agnihotrebhyaḥ brāhmaṇasya mukhe hutam

original: Manu07-85a/ samam abrāhmaṇe dānaṃ dviguṇaṃ brāhmaṇabruve |
analyzed: samam abrāhmaṇe dānam dviguṇam brāhmaṇabruve

original: Manu07-85c/ prādhīte ;satasāhasram anantaṃ vedapārage ‖ [ṃ-ācārye ;satasāhasram]] [;n: sahasraguṇam ācārye]
analyzed: prādhīte sata sāhasram anantam vedapārage ācārye sata sāhasram n sahasraguṇam ācārye

original: Manu07-86a/ pātrasya hi vi;seṣeṇa ;sraddadhānatayā-eva ca |
analyzed: pātrasya hi viseṣeṇa sraddadhāna tayā eva ca

original: Manu07-86c/ alpaṃ vā bahu vā pretya dānasya phalam a;snute ‖
analyzed: alpam vā bahu vā pretya dānasya phalam asnute

original: [Manu07-87ṃa/ de;sa-kālavidhānena dravyaṃ ;sraddhāsamanvitam / [not in K]
analyzed: dravyam sraddhā samanvita

original: [Manu07-87ṃc/ pātre pradīyate) yat tu tad dharmasya prasādhanam // [not in K]
analyzed: pātre pradīyate yat tu tad dharmasya prasādhanam not in

original: (Although ṃedhātithi comments on the above ;sloka, ;nha's edition does not count it in his numbering of the text- ṭherefore, ;nha ed-'s numbering is the same with K in the following)
analyzed: R although ṃedhātithi comments on the above sloka nhas edition does not count it in his numbering of the text therefore nha eds numbering is the same with K in the following

original: Manu07-87a[88ṃa]/ sama-uttama-adhamai rājā tv āhūtaḥ pālayan prajāḥ |
analyzed: rājā tu āhūtaḥ pālayan prajāḥ

original: Manu07-87c[88ṃc]/ na nivarteta saṃgrāmāt kṣātraṃ dharmam anusmaran ‖
analyzed: na nivarteta saṃgrāmāt kṣātram dharmam anusmaran

original: Manu07-88a[89ṃa]/ saṃgrāmeṣv anivartitvaṃ prajānāṃ ca-eva pālanam |
analyzed: saṃgrāmeṣu anivarti tvam prajānām ca eva pālanam

original: Manu07-88c[89ṃc]/ ;su;srūṣā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca rāj;nāṃ ;sreyaskaraṃ param ‖
analyzed: susrūṣā brāhmaṇānām ca rājnām sreyaskaram param

original: Manu07-89a[90ṃa]/ āhaveṣu mitho 'anyonyaṃ jighāṃsanto mahīkṣitaḥ |
analyzed: āhaveṣu mithas anyonyam jighāṃsantaḥ mahīkṣitaḥ

original: Manu07-89c[90ṃc]/ yudhyamānāḥ paraṃ ;saktyā svargaṃ yānty a-parā:nmukhāḥ ‖
analyzed: yudhyamānāḥ param saktyā svargam yānti aparānmukhāḥ

original: Manu07-90a[91ṃa]/ na kūṭair āyudhair hanyād yudhyamāno raṇe ripūn |
analyzed: na kūṭaiḥ āyudhaiḥ hanyāt yudhyamānaḥ raṇe ripūn

original: Manu07-90c[91ṃc]/ na karṇibhir na-api digdhair na-agnijvalita-tejanaiḥ ‖
